title: Dasakam 63 — Govardhanoddhāraṇam
description: Storm clouds gather over Vraja; Krishna lifts Govardhana to shelter the people and cattle, then lowers it as Indra's storm passes and the devas praise him.
translation_note: No vetted English verse translation was supplied or added; translation_en remains empty pending editorial review. Captions are commentary, not translations.

stanzas.sanskrit:
ददृशिरे किल तत्क्षणमक्षत-
स्तनितजृम्भितकम्पितदिक्तटाः ।
सुषमया भवदङ्गतुलां गता
व्रजपदोपरि वारिधरास्त्वया ॥ ६३-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dadṛśire kila tatkṣaṇamakṣata-
-stanitajṛmbhitakampitadiktaṭāḥ |
suṣamayā bhavadaṅgatulāṃ gatā
vrajapadopari vāridharāstvayā || 63-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Above the land of Vraja, heavy rain clouds were continuously roaring and spreading
which scared the people of Vraja. The colour of the clouds were as dark as the skin of Krishna.

stanzas.sanskrit:
विपुलकरकमिश्रैस्तोयधारानिपातै-
र्दिशि दिशि पशुपानां मण्डले दण्ड्यमाने ।
कुपितहरिकृतान्नः पाहि पाहीति तेषां
वचनमजित शृण्वन् मा बिभीतेत्यभाणीः ॥ ६३-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vipulakarakamiśraistoyadhārānipātai-
-rdiśi diśi paśupānāṃ maṇḍale daṇḍyamāne |
kupitaharikṛtānnaḥ pāhi pāhīti teṣāṃ
vacanamajita śṛṇvan mā bibhītetyabhāṇīḥ || 63-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
There was heavy rain in all directions with hail stones. The group of cowherds were terrified by the angry actions of Indra. They all cried and prayed to be protected. 
Hearing their cries, Krishna assured them once again not to fear.

stanzas.sanskrit:
कुल इह खलु गोत्रो दैवतं गोत्रशत्रो-
र्विहतिमिह स रुन्ध्यात् को नु वः संशयोऽस्मिन् ।
इति सहसितवादी देव गोवर्धनाद्रिं
त्वरितमुदमुमूलो मूलतो बालदोर्भ्याम् ॥ ६३-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kula iha khalu gotro daivataṃ gotraśatro-
-rvihatimiha sa rundhyāt ko nu vaḥ saṃśayo’smin |
iti sahasitavādī deva govardhanādriṃ
tvaritamudamumūlo mūlato bāladorbhyām || 63-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna said that Govardhana mountain is their protecting deity, So without any doubt,  it will only protect Vraja from the anger of Indra. Smilingly saying so, He uprooted the Govardhana mountain.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदनु गिरिवरस्य प्रोद्धृतस्यास्य तावत्
सिकतिलमृदुदेशे दूरतो वारितापे ।
परिकरपरिमिश्रान् धेनुगोपानधस्ता-
दुपनिदधदधत्था हस्तपद्मेन शैलम् ॥ ६३-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadanu girivarasya proddhṛtasyāsya tāvat
sikatilamṛdudeśe dūrato vāritāpe |
parikaraparimiśrān dhenugopānadhastā-
-dupanidadhadadhatthā hastapadmena śailam || 63-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna lifted the mountain in his lotus flower like finger and held it like an umbrella standing on a soft sand bed  of the mountain where rain water cannot reach. The entire gopas, cows and calf took shelter under the lifted mountain.

stanzas.sanskrit:
भवति विधृतशैले बालिकाभिर्वयस्यै-
रपि विहितविलासं केलिलापादिलोले ।
सविधमिलितधेनूरेकहस्तेन कण्डू-
यति सति पशुपालास्तोषमैषन्त सर्वे ॥ ६३-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhavati vidhṛtaśaile bālikābhirvayasyai-
-rapi vihitavilāsaṃ kelilāpādilole |
savidhamilitadhenūrekahastena kaṇḍū-
-yati sati paśupālāstoṣamaiṣanta sarve || 63-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: While holding the mountain in his tender hands, Krishna engaged himself in playful conversations with the Gopas. He pampered the cows and they were all very satisfied and delighted.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अतिमहान् गिरिरेष तु वामके
करसरोरुहि तं धरते चिरम् ।
किमिदमद्भुतमद्रिबलं न्विति
त्वदवलोकिभिराकथि गोपकैः ॥ ६३-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
atimahān girireṣa tu vāmake
karasaroruhi taṃ dharate ciram |
kimidamadbhutamadribalaṃ nviti
tvadavalokibhirākathi gopakaiḥ || 63-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The Gopas wondered, how Krishna is able to hold such a huge mountain on his tender left arm for such a long time. Was it due to the glory of the mountain itself?, they questioned Krishna.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अहह धार्ष्ट्यममुष्य वटोर्गिरिं
व्यथितबाहुरसाववरोपयेत् ।
इति हरिस्त्वयि बद्धविगर्हणो
दिवससप्तकमुग्रमवर्षयत् ॥ ६३-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ahaha dhārṣṭyamamuṣya vaṭorgiriṃ
vyathitabāhurasāvavaropayet |
iti haristvayi baddhavigarhaṇo
divasasaptakamugramavarṣayat || 63-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Indra was surprised too but then thought that Krishna, who was a young boy, cannot bear the weight of such a huge mountain and hence will drop it down for sure. With contempt, Indra made rain pour continuously for seven days.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अचलति त्वयि देव पदात्पदं
गलितसर्वजले च घनोत्करे ।
अपहृते मरुता मरुतां पति-
स्त्वदभिशङ्कितधीः समुपाद्रवत् ॥ ६३-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
acalati tvayi deva padātpadaṃ
galitasarvajale ca ghanotkare |
apahṛte marutā marutāṃ pati-
-stvadabhiśaṅkitadhīḥ samupādravat || 63-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna did not stir from his position. The clouds exhausted all its water and the wind (vayu) pushed the clouds far away. Indra noticing all the above, got really scared and ran away.

stanzas.sanskrit:
शममुपेयुषि वर्षभरे तदा
पशुपधेनुकुले च विनिर्गते ।
भुवि विभो समुपाहितभूधरः
प्रमुदितैः पशुपैः परिरेभिषे ॥ ६३-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śamamupeyuṣi varṣabhare tadā
paśupadhenukule ca vinirgate |
bhuvi vibho samupāhitabhūdharaḥ
pramuditaiḥ paśupaiḥ parirebhiṣe || 63-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The heavy rain then stopped and the cows and Gopas had come out from under the mountain. Krishna put the Govardhana mountain back to its place. Gopas hugged Krishna in happiness.

stanzas.sanskrit:
धरणिमेव पुरा धृतवानसि
क्षितिधरोद्धरणे तव कः श्रमः ।
इति नुतस्त्रिदशैः कमलापते
गुरुपुरालय पालय मां गदात् ॥ ६३-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dharaṇimeva purā dhṛtavānasi
kṣitidharoddharaṇe tava kaḥ śramaḥ |
iti nutastridaśaiḥ kamalāpate
gurupurālaya pālaya māṃ gadāt || 63-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Devas praised Krishna's mighty action and recollected how Krishna carried the earth in his Varaha avatar. For Him, lifting this Govardhana hills was not a difficult task at all.
Bhattathiri worshipped Bhagwan Guruvayoorappan to protect him from his afflictions.
